title: A sustainable infrared dry peeling method for shallots (Allium cepa L. aggregatum): comparison of nutritional, enzymatic and sensory characteristics of infrared and conventional peeling methods
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, 3,582-598
DOI: 10.1039/D4FB00372A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Deepika Sakthivel, Min Wu, P. P. Sutar
The impact of traditional and novel infrared peeling methods on shallot quality and sensory attributes was evaluated. Infrared dry peeling was identified as a sustainable method for quality retention.
